scope: 56 validation T/V observation pairs not covered by the two Round36 reports
review_method: Raw V and T images viewed by session and time in contact sheets before consulting existing labels or model predictions; class presence is preliminary, exact boxes are not adjudicated.

DJI_202609081039_006.visual_pattern: Early frames move from pre-ignition negative to right-side flame; late frames show upper-right smoke, while thermal displays more than one warm or bright region. Thermal brightness alone does not establish fire-relevant hotspot identity.
DJI_202609081039_006.priority_reason: Pre-ignition hard negative, weak flame/smoke boundary, or T/V target identity ambiguity.

DJI_202609081040_004.visual_pattern: Visible images mainly show left-edge smoke decaying over time; thermal images often contain two separated bright areas. Cross-sensor target identity is not recoverable from timestamp alone.
DJI_202609081040_004.priority_reason: Thermal color/contrast differs strongly from adjacent timepoints; inspect full-resolution source before judging box or usability.

DJI_202609081042_036.visual_pattern: Visible right-side flame is clear in earlier frames and becomes weak smoke or char later; a thermal bright region persists. Residual heat must be distinguished from active flame.
DJI_202609081042_036.priority_reason: Late-stage weak/absent visible flame with persistent thermal signal.

DJI_202609081048_005.visual_pattern: Visible fire evolves from early flame to prolonged smoke and hot debris. Thermal bright regions persist as visible flames wane; some visible fire is clipped by the frame edge. Smoke extent changes strongly with view and time.
DJI_202609081048_005.priority_reason: Clipped flame, late smoke versus residual hotspot, or changing camera viewpoint.

review_limitations: Contact sheets support presence/ambiguity triage, not precise YOLO box geometry.
Bright thermal regions can be hot ground, people, or other non-fire sources; hotspot class needs physical-context adjudication.
No current or historical model predictions were used for this screen.
Historical validation exposure elsewhere means this is a repaired development validation set, not an untouched blind test.
next_action: Compare existing V/T label boxes against these raw observations, inspect suspicious originals at full resolution, and keep all correction proposals isolated from original validation files.
